avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Bisphosphonates require acidic environment for GI absorption; calcium chelates ibandronate and significantly reduces bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Separate ibandronate and calcium supplements by at least 6 hours; administer ibandronate on empty stomach

avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Divalent cations chelate bisphosphonates, reducing absorption by 60-90%
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 6 hours; take ibandronate first on empty stomach

avoid_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Divalent cation forms insoluble complexes with bisphosphonates, reducing bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Administer ibandronate 6+ hours before or after magnesium supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Zinc supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Divalent cation chelation reduces bisphosphonate absorption

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Vitamin D enhances calcium absorption, potentially increasing GI interaction risk if taken with ibandronate
caution_supplements.action: Time vitamin D doses separately from ibandronate; monitor for adequate vitamin D status (target 30-50 ng/mL)

avoid_foods.name: Dairy products (milk, cheese, yogurt)
avoid_foods.mechanism: High calcium content chelates ibandronate and dramatically reduces absorption to subtherapeutic levels
avoid_foods.action: Maintain 30-minute fast before and 2 hours after ibandronate dose; avoid all dairy during this window

avoid_foods.name: Fortified cereals and plant-based milks (fortified)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Added calcium content reduces bisphosphonate bioavailability similar to dairy
avoid_foods.action: Consume fortified foods at least 2 hours after ibandronate dose

avoid_foods.name: High-mineral foods (spinach, collard greens, fortified OJ)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Oxalates and added minerals chelate bisphosphonates reducing absorption
avoid_foods.action: Separate these foods from ibandronate dosing by minimum 2 hours

caution_foods.name: Coffee/tea with food
caution_foods.mechanism: Tannins and food components in acidic beverages may affect absorption timing; not a direct interaction
caution_foods.action: Black coffee or plain tea without food additives acceptable; avoid with meals taken near ibandronate dose

monitoring_notes: Ibandronate requires strict empty-stomach administration (30 minutes fasting before, 2 hours after) with plain water only to ensure adequate absorption; monitor for GI side effects and ensure adequate vitamin D/calcium intake through separate, properly-timed dosing to maintain bone health while avoiding chelation interactions.
